messages.subject: Draft Particulars of Claim - for approval
messages.plaintextBody:
Richard,

Attached is the Particulars of Claim showing counsel's mark-up (tracked). The substantive figures are unchanged at £2.165m; counsel has tightened the performance term and added a remoteness point on the lost-production head. Please review the statement of truth - we'll need you to verify it before filing.

We aim to issue in the week of 2 February.

Tom Gallagher

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
